g.title: feature_workflow
g.text: Feature workflow: a ticket becomes a reviewed pull request

g.title: intake
g.text: clone the repository · make a copy for the agents

g.title: analyst
g.text: is the request clear enough to build?

g.title: ask1
g.text: waits for a person (4 rounds at most)

g.title: developer
g.text: writes the code and its tests

g.title: publish
g.text: commit · push factory/issue-N · open the pull request

g.title: wip
g.text: factory/issue-N-wip + a comment on the ticket

g.title: fel1
g.text: agent (a role file in a sandbox)

g.title: fel3
g.text: deterministic check the factory runs itself
